paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled “Recall@10,” illustrates the performance of four different methods on the INSPIRED dataset, as part of an ablation study from the paper “Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative Reward Model Based Simulated User.” The horizontal axis displays four categorical methods: “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking,” which are labeled with a slanted font. The vertical axis represents the Recall@10 metric, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.4, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The bar for “Ours” is orange and reaches a value of approximately 0.35. The bar for “- critiquing” is blue and reaches approximately 0.30. The bar for “- scoring” is blue and reaches approximately 0.17. The bar for “- ranking” is blue and reaches approximately 0.23. All bars are of equal width and are presented in a single group, with no stacking or sub-grouping. The bars are arranged in the order listed on the x-axis, from left to right, and are not sorted by height. There is no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar.
